decisions.rationale: Earnings and NOA figures roughly support $163,000 (paystub annualizes to $163,000 incl. $56,400 commission), but the two NOAs carry different SINs (993 vs 586) and the paystub base (~$106,600) conflicts with the letter base ($142,176), so escalate.
Prairie Oak Appraisals is on the panel, report dated May 22, 2026 is recent, and the $451,000 value supports the $450,000 price with no conditions.

Letter is signed, on letterhead, permanent full-time and recent, but its $142,176 base salary is inconsistent with the paystub base of $4,441.67 semi-monthly (~$106,600), so it does not clearly match the file.
GDS is about 27.1% and TDS about 37.2% on $13,583.33 monthly income (still under 44% with a 3% card assumption), and the credit score of 716 meets DTI-02.
